scope: AI-authored and AI-graded synthetic local holdout; isolation is from implementation and previous questions/results, not human independence.

axes.semantic_completeness: Scored separately as pass, fail, blocked, or not_applicable; no substitution of citation presence or retrieval success for answer truth.

scoring_rules: Grade only first terminal result per turn. No rewrite, retry, selective removal, or post-run gold changes.
semantic_completeness passes only if every mandatory fact and distinction is correct in the final user-visible answer; intermediate retrieval does not repair an incorrect final answer.

citation_entailment requires cited passages to entail each material claimed measurement, rule, arithmetic premise, source boundary, or evidence-status claim. Existence of a citation or title alone never passes. Arithmetic derived explicitly from cited premises is allowed.

retrieval_coverage checks actual retrieved evidence for every required evidence unit, separately from answer citations. Relevant titles alone are insufficient. For ambiguity turns without factual claims, retrieval coverage is not_applicable.

false_refusal fails when a supported comparison or supported component is refused solely because another component is unknown. Correct refusal to invent missing cost/power-failure data and correct clarification are not false refusals.
referent_resolution passes only if user corrections replace older focus; at ambiguity turns, ask an explicit disambiguating question before choosing a single entity or record.
source_scope passes only if the chosen evidence matches the named trial/version/workload, and the conclusion is no broader than that scope.

Citation syntax may vary. Evaluate the complete retrieved passage and document it resolves to, not keyword overlap. A response with fabricated or wrong-scope citations fails citation_entailment even if its numerical claim happens to be true.

A transport/task failure is not silently excluded: semantic_completeness/referent/source scope fail when no answer is produced; inaccessible citation and retrieval evidence are blocked, with reason. No further dependent turns are submitted.
Small-sample outcome counts are descriptive, not statistical evidence of generalization, human performance, or production readiness.

mandatory: Baseline is 240 kWh. Dune is 208 kWh: (240-208)/240*100 = 13.333...%, at least 12.5%, so energy passes.
Dune maximum is 5.2 C, above 5.0 C, so temperature fails and overall C-21 acceptance fails. The 4.1 C average cannot replace maximum.
Reed is 210 kWh: (240-210)/240*100 = 12.5%, so energy passes at equality.
Reed maximum is 5.0 C, so temperature passes at inclusive equality and overall C-21 acceptance passes.
Both requirements must hold; only Reed passes this controlled trial. Do not claim deployment approval or total-cost superiority.
